name: E21 beaconing scorer v2 (preregistration)
note: Design and gate fixed before any v2 scoring code is run on data. Nothing is fitted to data. Any change after a held-out run needs a committed amendment with its reason. Dataset hashes for held-out sets A and B are added by amendment when they exist.

scorer.pair_key: (source host, SNI if the flow has one else destination IP); verdict carries the SNI and the set of destination IPs seen
scorer.state_per_pair: newest 512 flows as (start_ts, forward bytes, duration_s); first_seen; hourly flow counts; PAIR_CAP kept; all state bounded
scorer.now: largest flow timestamp the tracker has observed (capture clock, never wall clock)
scorer.long_flows: a flow longer than 1 h counts in every hour bin it spans

components.G: mean of (1 - |bowley(gaps)|) and (1 - min(1, MAD(gaps)/median(gaps))); bowley = (Q3 + Q1 - 2*Q2)/(Q3 - Q1), 0 when Q3 == Q1; gaps between consecutive start times
components.S: same two formulas on forward bytes; 0 if median is 0
components.D: active hour bins / total hour bins between first_seen and now inclusive, capped at the 24 newest bins
components.H: 1 - min(1, MAD(counts)/median(counts)) over the same hour bins including empty ones; 0 if median count is 0

minimum_evidence.score_exists: D available and at least one of G or H available; otherwise no verdict

scorer.score: unweighted mean of the available components
scorer.allow_list: semantics unchanged; EMPTY for every gate run
known_consequences: nothing can alert in the first 3 h of a pair
a 1 h beacon needs about 12 h
captures shorter than 3 h give no verdict

evaluation.dev_smoke_only: CIC-2018 Bot day has already been seen: reported in its own row, never in the gate
evaluation.set_A: CTU-13 botnet C2 pairs vs CTU-Normal 2017 benign pairs (held out)
evaluation.set_B: lab C2 corpus generated after this file is committed (held out); dataset hashes added by amendment when they exist

gate.recall: >= 0.8 at <= 1 false pair per 1000 benign pairs (zero false pairs when fewer than 1000)
gate.vs_rita: recall not more than 0.05 below real RITA v5.1.2 on the same pairs
gate.set_B_jitter: gated at jitter <= 50 %; 75 % reported as a curve only

evaluation.on_failure: report 'ranking aid, not a detector'; flag stays off; numbers published; no retuning in the same session
